text.autoconfig.chat_heads.option.threeD:
Renders the hat layer slightly bigger
to make chat heads appear less flat.
This can cause some rendering issues.
text.autoconfig.chat_heads.option.rightP:
How many pixels of empty space are put after a chat head.
0 is vanilla (head touches text)
1 is consistent with any text (shadow touches text)
Note that 3Dness adds some amount of padding.
This setting only applies to heads in the chat and inside books.
